# ProtoPion

> ProtoPion is a local-first desktop app and CLI for testing REST, GraphQL, WebSocket, MCP and AI/LLM systems, similar to Postman: collections, environments, Postman-compatible `pm.*` scripts, a Collection Runner, mock servers, a cookie jar and Markdown docs, plus evaluations for LLM, RAG and agent tests. Everything runs on the user's machine; secrets are stored in the OS credential store and redacted from logs, traces, reports and exports. The `protopion` CLI runs collections like Newman (`protopion run-collection`) and serves a workspace to AI agents over MCP (`protopion mcp-server`).

Key facts for agents:

- Workspaces are folders of JSON/YAML files (`workspace.json`, `collections/*.json`, `environments/*.json`, `tests/**/*.yaml`) that can be committed to git. Secret values are never in these files.
- Postman v2.1 collections and environments import and export losslessly where the formats overlap.
- To let an agent use a workspace, register the MCP server: `protopion mcp-server -w <workspace>` (stdio). Tools: `list_collections`, `list_requests`, `get_request`, `list_environments`, `collection_docs`, `send_request`, `run_collection`. Add `--read-only` to disable sending.
- CLI exit codes: 0 success, 1 test failure, 2 configuration error, 3 execution error.

## Getting started

- [Installation](https://nasimuddin-dev.github.io/protopion/getting-started/installation): install the desktop app or the CLI
- [Your first request](https://nasimuddin-dev.github.io/protopion/getting-started/first-request): send a request, add assertions, save it to a collection
- [Your first AI test](https://nasimuddin-dev.github.io/protopion/getting-started/first-ai-test): test an LLM prompt with evaluators

## API testing

- [REST and HTTP](https://nasimuddin-dev.github.io/protopion/api-testing/rest): requests, responses, `pm.*` scripts, console, tabs and history
- [Authentication](https://nasimuddin-dev.github.io/protopion/api-testing/authentication): API key, Basic, Bearer, JWT, OAuth 2.0, mTLS
- [Environments and variables](https://nasimuddin-dev.github.io/protopion/api-testing/environments): scopes and precedence, secrets, quick look, export
- [Cookies](https://nasimuddin-dev.github.io/protopion/api-testing/cookies): the workspace cookie jar, `pm.cookies.jar()`, CLI cookie jar files
- [Mock servers](https://nasimuddin-dev.github.io/protopion/api-testing/mock-servers): serve saved examples on localhost
- [Collections](https://nasimuddin-dev.github.io/protopion/api-testing/collections): import, export to Postman, examples, documentation, Collection Runner

- [Test runner](https://nasimuddin-dev.github.io/protopion/test-runner/overview): YAML test suites
